svg.title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer v1.1.0 · Figure 6 · The Bit Delivered Twice: Two Kinds And No Third
svg.text: FIGURE 6
THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE: TWO KINDS AND NO THIRD
BIRCH AND SWINNERTON-DYER · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 10 · THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE, BY ITS TWO KINDS, AND NO THIRD
KIND 1 · THE FORMAL CARGO
The record's value carried to the host's frame. It arrives free, the
antecedent a theorem; it gives rank equal to order in one step; and it is
exactly the sentence.

svg.text: KIND 2 · THE PHYSICAL WITNESS
Each curve's group of rational points is a physical register whose free
directions are each registered at one Landauer floor quantum, the curve at
one more, so its heat is rank plus one; the carrier registers the free
directions as the zero modes at the centre. Its last field is the bit, carried
as a field, never proved.

svg.text: The two kinds are one bit
The physical witness is a formal cargo, and the
cargo is exactly the sentence.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Two kinds and no third
Every witness of the sentence, in any vocabulary, is
a delivery of both kinds.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The one refuter
One curve whose rank is not its order refutes both
kinds at once, and the sentence itself.

svg.text: THE WITNESSES OF THE SUBJECT, TYPED · EACH STRICTLY INSIDE THE BIT OR STRICTLY STRONGER
The low-order witness
Inside the bit and strictly smaller: a curve of rank
zero at order two carries it and fails the sentence.

svg.text: The retired premise Ω
It gives the value and is strictly stronger; it is
retired, never the ground.
